title: 第21章 清雅小筑第22章 过夜
slug: 提前登陆游戏世界开局联姻女帝
content_zh:
“清雅小筑，名字倒是好听！”
夏辰赞叹了一句，如此高雅的名字，但谁能想到，里面是心灵交流场所呢！
李喜很有眼力劲的去敲门，然后一边给夏辰讲解着。
“清雅姑娘，是小院主人，在京城小有名气，很受文人的追捧，听说这间院子，就连一些朝中官员老爷，有时都会来这里。
进小院中，除了交入门费和酒水费之外，后续夜里能不能够留在院中，就得看个人才华能不能被清雅姑娘看中了，不过就算清雅姑娘没有看中，也是可以选一些丫鬟侍女的！”清雅姑娘在京城名气极大，是有名的美人......　　夏辰有些诧异，这清雅姑娘很有商业头脑啊，这清雅小筑不活脱脱的是高档私人会所吗？
凭借着清雅姑娘自身的个人Ip，打造名气，然后又凭借着你情我愿的特色，与其他青楼勾栏等地拉开差距，打造差异化，提高产品竞争力。
这种披着你情我愿的特色模式，必定会吸引那些文人读书人的好奇，都说文无第一，武无第二，读书人眼光颇高，都不会认为自己比其他人差。
而且越是得不到的，大家就越想得到，一次来这里消费没能过夜，那就第二次，第三次……
那种看得着却摸不着的感觉，能勾的人心痒痒的，从而又再一次提高了回头复购率。
真是绝呀！
夏辰点了点头，对这个清雅姑娘有些好奇了，只是不知道这间小院当家主人是那个清雅还是另有其人。
“可有请帖！”
这时，清雅小筑大门后探出一个小脑袋，脸颊圆圆的，面容清秀，看上去颇为可爱。
李喜连忙将手中的请帖递了进去，很快大门被打开，夏辰早就已经带好李喜提前准备好的面具，一进去夏辰便闻到了一股扑鼻的胭脂味儿。
圆脸丫鬟带着三人进入院落中，院落中此时已经有不少人了，约莫二三十号人，皆都做文人打扮，此时看到三人进来，也只是抬头望了一眼便收回目光。
夏辰在末席落座，然后便开始认真打量了起来。
院子中，莺莺燕燕的，有侍女翩翩起舞，也有人在玩行酒令，飞花令等。
夏辰看了几眼便收回目光，目光放到了院子中心，那翩翩起舞的舞女身上。
除了衣着略为清凉之外，舞女气质出众，不像是媚俗中人，反而像是大家闺秀，这种气质，也难怪这间普通的清雅小院这么受追捧。
果真是清雅脱俗，就是不知那位清雅姑娘究竟是何模样。

“想来容貌应该更出众一些，否则的话，名声也不会这么大。”
夏辰内心琢磨着，突然耳边听到一阵极为好听的琴音，而席间也略微有些骚动。
“清雅姑娘要出来了！”
夏辰静静的倾听这动人的琴声，直到琴音渐息，耳边才传来李喜声音。
“清雅姑娘，诗词歌赋音律等样样精通，其中特别是这古琴号称一绝，有人赞叹，清雅姑娘的琴，不输于教坊司的姑娘。”
夏辰点了点头，目光向屋内望去，只看到一道窈窕身影，在灯火的照耀下若隐若现，映照在屏风上。
“诸位公子久等了！”
一道清冷动听的声音传来，一位丽人从屏风后走了出来，脸上挂着微笑，顿时，在场的所有人即便戴着面具，眼睛也都一亮。
好一位大家闺秀！
夏辰看到这位清雅姑娘的庐山真面目之后，不禁一笑，这玩的是……反差感吗？
content_en:
"Qingya Xiaozhu, the name is really nice!"
Xia Chen praised it, such an elegant name, but who would have thought that it is a place for spiritual communication inside!
Li Xi knocked on the door very discerningly, and then explained to Xia Chen.
"Miss Qingya is the owner of the small courtyard. She is well-known in the capital and is very popular among literati. I heard that even some officials from the DPRK and the Central Government sometimes come here to this courtyard.
When entering the small courtyard, in addition to paying the entrance fee and the drink fee, whether you can stay in the courtyard at night depends on whether your personal talent can be noticed by the Qingya girl. However, even if the Qingya girl is not interested, you can still choose some maids! "Miss Qingya is very famous in the capital. She is a famous beauty... Xia Chen was a little surprised. This girl Qingya is very business-savvy. Doesn't this Qingya small building just look like a high-end private club?
Relying on Qingya girl's own personal IP, she builds her reputation, and then relies on the characteristics of "you and me" to widen the gap with other brothel goulan and other places, create differentiation and improve product competitiveness.
This characteristic model of love between you and me will definitely attract the curiosity of those scholars. It is said that there is no first in literature and no second in martial arts. Scholars have a high vision and will not think that they are inferior to others.
And the more you can’t get it, the more people want it. If you don’t spend the night here once, then the second time, the third time...
That kind of feeling that can be seen but cannot be touched can tickle people's hearts, thus once again increasing the repurchase rate.
It’s absolutely amazing!
Xia Chen nodded, a little curious about this Qingya girl, but he didn't know whether the owner of this small courtyard was Qingya or someone else.
"Is there an invitation?"
At this time, a little head poked out from behind the gate of Qingya Xiaozhu. It had round cheeks and a pretty face, and looked quite cute.
Li Xi quickly handed the invitation in his hand, and soon the door was opened. Xia Chen had already put on the mask that Li Xi had prepared in advance. As soon as he entered, Xia Chen smelled the tangy smell of rouge.
The round-faced maid led the three people into the courtyard. There were already many people in the courtyard, about twenty or thirty people, all dressed as scholars. When they saw the three people coming in, they just looked up and looked away.
Xia Chen sat down at the last table, and then began to look at it carefully.
In the courtyard, there were birds and birds, maids dancing gracefully, and some people playing wine-making, flying-flower-making, etc.
Xia Chen looked at it for a few times and then looked away, focusing on the dancing girl in the center of the courtyard.
In addition to the slightly cool clothes, the dancer has an outstanding temperament. She does not look like a kitsch person, but like a lady. With this kind of temperament, it is no wonder that this ordinary elegant courtyard is so popular.
It's really elegant and refined, but I don't know what that elegant girl looks like.
"I guess my appearance should be more outstanding, otherwise, my reputation wouldn't be so great."
Xia Chen was thinking in his heart, and suddenly he heard a very pleasant piano sound, and there was a slight commotion in the table.
"Miss Qingya is coming out!"
Xia Chen listened quietly to the moving sound of the piano. It was not until the sound of the piano gradually died down that Li Xi's voice came to his ears.
"Miss Qingya is proficient in all kinds of poetry, songs, music, and music. Among them, the guqin in particular is known as a masterpiece. Some people praise that Miss Qingya's piano is not inferior to that of the girl from Jiaofangsi."
Xia Chen nodded and looked into the room, only to see a slim figure, looming under the light of the lights, reflected on the screen.
"You gentlemen, you have been waiting for a long time!"
A cold and melodious voice came, and a beauty walked out from behind the screen with a smile on her face. Suddenly, everyone present's eyes lit up even though they were wearing masks.
What a beautiful lady!
After Xia Chen saw the true face of this elegant girl from Lushan, he couldn't help but smile. Is this playing with... a sense of contrast?
